family.description: This domain is part of an RNase-H fold section in a number of hAT-like transposases, such as protein DAYSLEEPER (At3g42170) from Arabidopsis [[cite:PUB00070967]]. Protein DAYSLEEPER is essential for plant development and can also regulate global gene expression [[cite:PUB00070969]]. This entry also includes some uncharacterised fungal proteins.
family.name: hAT-like transposase, RNase-H fold
